experiments.title: 高选择性 customer_id：无索引与添加索引

before.label: customer_id 无索引
before.query: SELECT id, customer_id, created_at, status, total FROM public.orders WHERE customer_id = 42 ORDER BY id

after.label: customer_id 有索引
after.query: SELECT id, customer_id, created_at, status, total FROM public.orders WHERE customer_id = 42 ORDER BY id

experiments.title: created_at 日期函数与半开范围（日期索引已存在）

before.label: date(created_at) 函数条件
before.query: SELECT id, customer_id, created_at, status, total FROM public.orders WHERE date(created_at) = date '2024-06-15' ORDER BY id

after.label: created_at 半开范围
after.query: SELECT id, customer_id, created_at, status, total FROM public.orders WHERE created_at >= timestamp '2024-06-15 00:00:00' AND created_at < timestamp '2024-06-16 00:00:00' ORDER BY id
